Your next play session

Get the mount, then the points.

  1. For the normal PoF unlock, train Raptor · Canyon Jumping, complete the Highjump Ranch heart in Desert Highlands, then buy the Springer from Stablemaster Unja for 1 gold + 50 Trade Contracts.
  2. Once purchased, record basic Springer below. High Vault is a separate mastery; the basic mount already opens several of this map’s challenges.
  3. Open Desert Highlands and take the available stops. Your route limits assess climbing and waiting; with fight tolerance at maximum, combat does not lower a stop’s priority.

How far the desert gets you

The first two PoF maps contain 120 HP; the first three contain 200 HP; all five contain 290 HP. These are catalogue totals, before completed points and travel limits. Starting with no spare HP, the first three maps alone leave 50 HP to find for Weaver. Unused HoT points can cover that gap without revealing later desert maps.

Fresh setup: plan PoF only, reveal the first two maps, and leave Springer unticked until purchased. The entire HoT + PoF catalogue remains available. To include jungle leftovers, first mark your known clears, then change “Plan region” to all revealed maps. Existing saved settings are preserved.

Your second elite specialization

250 more, not 500 more.

A fully trained Tempest already represents 250 HP. Weaver needs its own 250 HP, making 500 invested across the two. Keep playing Tempest while earning and spending points on Weaver; training it does not require equipping it.

Your unspent balance and any points already trained into Weaver reduce what remains. The setup above accounts for those separately from Tempest. This is a manual tracker, not your live game balance.

Hero challenges pay their points once per character. Mark old HoT clears as Completed before / elsewhere. HoT’s catalogue contains 400 HP, so there may be useful leftovers even after funding Tempest; the guide cannot guess which you used.

Training rules ↗

Zero future-map sightseeing

The WvW detour.

WvW’s Heroics Notary sells notarized heroics scrolls. A Maguuma, Desert or Jade scroll completes one random unfinished challenge in its region and awards 10 HP, subject to owning that expansion. If that character has finished every challenge in the region, the scroll returns currency instead of awarding more HP.

  1. Check your wallet and the notary’s current scroll costs.
  2. Buy and consume the relevant scrolls on the character that needs the points.
  3. Add the actual new points to “Other HP earned”. Mark any corresponding catalogue challenges “Completed before / elsewhere”, not “Earned here”.

Do the easy map challenges first if you want random scrolls to clear harder leftovers. If you already play WvW, this can be convenient; starting from no currency is a separate time investment.

Optional · up to 310 HP

End of Dragons, at your pace.

All 31 challenges are in the catalogue, including the hub’s single challenge. Start with the first map’s nine stops or keep the entire expansion hidden. Later names, map art and routes stay behind the separate staged boundary.

A friend already there can provide a Teleport to Friend destination. An accessible guild-hall exit or an already-owned lounge pass can offer another route. You still need End of Dragons ownership.

Low story exposure is not zero world exposure. You will see future scenery and may hear ambient dialogue. Avoid starting the expansion story just to get points.

The early desert option.

The first three PoF maps contain 200 HP in total. You don’t need every one: leave awkward climbs out if you prefer. Choose “first three PoF maps”, then enable only the maps you can reach.

For most of your original easy route, the useful kit is basic gliding, Raptor with Canyon Jumping, basic Springer and basic Skimmer. The planner will not assume you own those unlocks.

Normal PoF unlock path: train Raptor Canyon Jumping, then complete the relevant ranch heart. Springer costs 1 gold + 50 Trade Contracts; Skimmer costs 4 gold + 50 Trade Contracts. Canyon Jumping is a condition for these unlocks. Mastery training needs both XP and mastery points.

The new-profile starting boundary reveals only the first two PoF maps. Reveal the next map when you reach it. Full PoF coverage does not require showing every future location on screen now.

How to use the atlas.

  1. Add a character. At level 80, fully train core skills and specializations before training an elite. Enter only usable credit toward your chosen elite goal.
  2. Set your world boundary and tick your real unlocks and map access.
  3. Open “My route”. It chooses eligible unfinished stops in your plan region, preferring less travel and fewer waits, then groups them by map and suggested order.
  4. Copy a waypoint into your GW2 chat box to find it. The code cannot unlock an undiscovered waypoint.
  5. Earn, skip, or mark previously completed points. Every character has its own status and notes.

The order is a planning aid, not a live navigation engine or guaranteed shortest route. If it cannot reach your goal, the shortfall remains visible.

Keep your progress safe.

The file works offline. Text, maps, filters and checklists are inside it. HoT and PoF use terrain maps; the optional dip uses an explicitly labeled coordinate overview. Only source links need the internet; no account key or add-on is needed.

Browser storage is local to that browser and file location. It may not follow a renamed file or from a download to a hosted link. Progress does not sync between devices; export a backup and restore it in the other browser. Some mobile file viewers disable scripts or storage. Open the downloaded HTML in a full browser, then use Back up progress.

Old guide backups are supported. Restore the JSON from Road to 250 to carry over characters, completed points, starting credit and notes. All restored backups reopen with HoT-only protection. If another tab changes your save, this tab preserves your local edits and asks you to back them up before resolving the conflict.

Secrets of the Obscure and Janthir Wilds do not add hero challenges. The newer elite-spec expansion you said you do not own is not included.

Catalogue, evidence & limitations

HoT and PoF catalogue audited 9 October 2026; EoD catalogue, prerequisites and API coordinates researched 17 October 2026. Complete inventories: 40 HoT + 29 PoF + 31 EoD challenges, 1,000 HP across eligible first completions. EoD remains a separate opt-in. Each first completion gives 10 HP; daily reward repeats do not.

Revealed map Challenges HP Sources

The 100 challenge identities use ArenaNet API coordinates and waypoint records matched to GW2 Wiki identities. Challenge mechanics and prerequisites were checked against the wiki’s challenge pages, map lists and mastery pages; GuildJen supplies additional visual references. Where a general list conflicts with a detailed mechanic, the specific source takes precedence: powered transport needs a jade bot, and the hub trainer needs its account mastery. Embedded movement videos were not reviewed. Routes with incomplete text evidence are marked “Approach partly documented”. They remain eligible within your limits unless their requirements are unconfirmed; that uncertain approach remains in the catalogue but is excluded from automatic plans. Use “documented approaches only” for a stricter plan. Difficulty, route ranking and spoiler exposure are editorial judgments. Mount requirements describe the written approach, not a proven minimum across every possible shortcut.

Map imagery and game data © ArenaNet / NCSoft. Unofficial fan guide. Map images show a single terrain layer; cave and canopy directions take precedence over the flat image. This has been checked as a guide and web application, not play-tested in-game.
